_comment: EXAMPLE (CSAIL, from 2026-11-18). Copy to sites/csail.json, replace /data/hai-res/<you> with your dirs, set "mail" to your address (optional), and check slots/accounts/QoS against sacctmgr.
_comment_2026_11_17: Step 0: multi-node shapes are NOT --exclusive here (shared nodes are almost never fully idle) and ask for one building ('[holyoke|stata]' matching-OR: all nodes in the same one). max_cpus_per_gpu / max_mem_per_gpu_gb cap the run's per-GPU CPU/RAM on slots whose nodes are smaller (V100 / 2080 Ti / Titan RTX: 80 CPUs + ~500 GB per 8 GPUs; isola-ada6000-1 220 GB per 7; torralba-3090 250 GB per 7). vs-titanrtx (24 GB) is Turing: no native bf16, so they are for smokes / small jobs, not the SA3 trainers. vision-shared-rtx2080ti is NOT a slot: torch 2.7.1+cu126 cannot initialise CUDA on its nodes (driver 580, 'CUDA unknown error' / error 804), tested on gpu19-1/2.drl and isola-2080ti-1..4.
_comment_gpu_preflight: 2026-11-17: every job (single-node too) checks torch.cuda.device_count() == allocated GPUs per node before training; a node that fails is excluded (bad_node) and the job re-races. gpu20-2.drl (Titan RTX) shows one GPU fewer than allocated; the 2080 Ti nodes fail CUDA init entirely.
_comment_policy: 2026-11-17: policy defaults for every CSAIL run. shape_backoff: a job that fails with no checkpoint progress is charged to its shape (backoff 1 h, doubling to 6 h, after 2 in a row), not to the run; 8 in a row on any shapes still halt.
_comment_multinode: 2026-11-17 step 0: NCCL inter-node = RoCE (NET/IB, mlx5) only between nodes on the same 128.30.x /24 (203: vision-shared h200/l40s/beery-a100/andreas-h100; 204: aia/khattab csail-shared-h200; 195: agrawal/freeman/isola/torralba). Across subnets NCCL fails at init ('Could not find NET with id 0', beery-a100-1 + freeman-a100-1); nodes without an RDMA NIC (agrawal-a100-1, agrawal-h100-1, agrawal-v100-1) force sockets, 0.16 GB/s busbw. multinode_exclude keeps each slot's multi-node shapes on one RoCE subnet.
